title: The Aperiodic Einstein Monotile on the Cusp Torus of Alpöge’s Complex Six-Sphere
summary: The cusp fibre W of Alpöge’s complex structure on the six-sphere is the [3.4.6.4] Laves tiling rolled up on a torus T = R2 /Λ, Λ = B0 Z2 , and at the proportions of the Hat that tiling is exactly the substrate of the aperiodic monotile: hexagon centres are components, edge midpoints double curves, hexagon vertices triple points. No monotile tiling descends to T, since an aperiodic tiling is invariant under no lattice. We fold a Hat tiling generated by substitution onto T anyway. Every tile is a union of whole kites, so the fold is well defined, and we compute its fibres. The "mystic" tile…

review.reason: Analyzes folding an aperiodic monotile substitution tiling onto a torus and computes its fibres.
